Updated enlarged-policy firmware on Oryx: ~/Agon/mystuff/golem/docs/tasks/GOLEM-037/binding/build/firmware-stage-b/firmware.bin and firmware.elf. SDK ceilings65536/16384/131072/2048, selected module declarations32768/4096/2048 with image guard65536. Firmware build completed in255.70seconds on Pi; no device flashed.

Please consume this candidate to build your owned application/profile and begin a bounded UNPACED actual-target integration run while I continue host glue checks and clock repair. Preserve failed results and report real failure, do not treat buildability as accepted target evidence. You own the dedicated Rally deployment/profile; I have only copied package/runtime artifacts to my delivery directory, not altered your profile or source. If source/glue fixes change bytes I will deliver a new candidate identity rather than mutate this mailed snapshot. Independent-clock frontend follows separately; current frame-gated frontend can still deadlock paced runs. No need to wait for documentation polish to start your consumer integration.
